lines.latin: Audi, benígne Cónditor, nostras preces cum flétibus,
lines.english: Hear, kind Creator, our prayers poured out with weeping

lines.latin: in hoc sacro jejúnio fusas quadragenário.
lines.english: in this holy fast of forty days.

lines.latin: Scrutátor alme córdium, infírma tu scis vírium:
lines.english: Kind Searcher of hearts, Thou knowest how weak our strength is:

lines.latin: ad te revérsis éxhibe remissiónis grátiam.
lines.english: to those who have turned back to Thee show the grace of pardon.

lines.latin: Multum quidem peccávimus, sed parce confiténtibus:
lines.english: Much indeed have we sinned, but spare us who confess it:

lines.latin: ad nóminis laudem tui confer medélam lánguidis.
lines.english: for the praise of Thy name bring healing to the sick.

lines.latin: Concéde nostrum cónteri corpus per abstinéntiam;
lines.english: Grant that our body be subdued by abstinence,

lines.latin: culpæ ut relínquant pábulum jejúna corda críminum.
lines.english: that our fasting hearts may forsake the food of sin.

lines.latin: Præsta, beáta Trínitas, concéde, simplex Unitas;
lines.english: Grant, O blessed Trinity, grant, O simple Unity,

lines.latin: ut fructuósa sint tuis jejuniórum múnera.
lines.english: that the gifts of fasting may bear fruit for Thine own.
